brief:
An elderly, disabled Palestinian man was beaten by an Israeli settler wielding a club in Hebron, in the occupied West Bank, according to Quds News Network. The attack was captured on video, which QNN subsequently released showing the assault.

The incident adds to a pattern of settler violence in the territory. Details about the victim's injuries, the circumstances that preceded the attack, and any response from Israeli authorities or security forces remained unclear from the available reporting.
